“Writing a Wikipedia RSS Link Archive Bot”

Gwern

2009

Haskell, Internet archiving, tutorial, Wikipedia

Archiving using Wikipedia Recent Changes RSS feed (obsolete).

Continuation of the 200917ya Haskell Wikipedia link archiving bot tutorial, extending it from operating on a pre-specified list of articles to instead archiving links live by using TagSoup parsing Wikipedia Recent Changes for newly-added external links which can be archived using WebCite in parallel. (Note: these tutorials are obsolete. WebCite is largely defunct, doing archiving this way is not advised, and WP link archiving is currently handled by Internet Archive-specific plugins by the WMF. For a more general approach suitable for personal use, see the writeup of archiver-bot in Archiving URLs.)
